about: The introitus of the formulary “Easter Sunday” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: I have risen, and I am still with You, alleluia. You laid Your hand upon me, alleluia. Your knowledge has proved wondrous, alleluia, alleluia. Lord, You have examined me and You know me. You know when I sit down and when I rise. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen. I have risen, and I am still with You, alleluia. You laid Your hand upon me, alleluia. Your knowledge has proved wondrous, alleluia, alleluia.
